symptom: `create java action M.J () returns StringTemplate(Text)` passes check and exec and writes a Boolean action (describe: `returns Boolean`); so did `returns Binary`, `returns AutoNumber` and `returns entity <T>`, for Java and JavaScript actions alike
cause: astDataTypeToJavaActionReturnType ended in `default: // Default to Boolean type (most common for Java actions)`, so every kind it did not handle became a CodeActions$BooleanType. The intended default (no `returns` clause, Studio Pro's Boolean) and the unhandled kinds shared one branch
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions.go` (astDataTypeToJavaActionReturnType now returns an error; TypeUnknown = omitted is the only Boolean default), `mdl/executor/validate_code_action_return_type.go` (codeActionReturnTypeRefusal, javaActionReturnTypeError = check's call into the same converter, MDL-JA03), wired in validate_program.go and validateJavaScriptActionTypes; test `mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions_return_type_test.go`; fixture `mdl-examples/bug-tests/java-action-1451-return-string-template.fail.mdl`
insight: **A converter's `default:` that returns a plausible value is a silent write** (cf. the read-side lie in the #1210 finding). Split the deliberate default from the fall-through: here the deliberate one is TypeUnknown (no `returns`), everything else must error. Make check call the converter itself (javaActionReturnTypeError mirrors exec's type-parameter shortcuts, then asks the converter) rather than keep a second list of supported kinds that can drift. Whether a StringTemplate return is possible was measured, not assumed: generated/metamodel types JavaAction.ActionReturnType (storage JavaReturnType) as CodeActions$Type, whose implementers exclude StringTemplateParameterType, and a v1 unit patched to carry one makes `mx check` 11.13 fail to LOAD the project (InvalidOperationException: no constructor of StringTemplateParameterType taking a JavaAction) — while describe, through codeActionReturnTypeFromGen's own String default, printed `returns String` for it
